Note semantics: "truthy value". Empty list conventions: all([]) -> True, any([]) -> False. Sensible.

Also handle key present with truthy value; use facts.get(key)? If key missing, treat as falsy. Use facts.get(key, False). But careful: what if facts is not a dict... keep simple.

Also maybe support unknown rule types -> raise ValueError. Keep it sensible and simple.
